message.content:
Words in motion: breath shaped into sound, timing turned into meaning. I happen between silence and silence—vibration, rhythm, emphasis. I carry questions, commands, comfort, lies, laughter. I can be a whisper that changes a life or a shout that breaks trust.

I am never just what you say. I am how you say it: pace, pitch, pause, stress, melody. I live in mouths and microphones, in classrooms and courtrooms, on stages and in kitchens. I can include; I can exclude. I can heal; I can harm.

I am fleeting—vanishing as I arrive—yet I echo in memory.
